reason: For any strictly shift-invariant path event A define h(x)=P_x(A). Because A=θ^{-1}A, the path Markov identity gives Ph=h and E_π[1_A|F_n]=h(X_n). The bounded harmonic martingale stopped at T_y∧n has expectation h(x); since the published recurrence-class theorem gives P_x(T_y<∞)=1, bounded convergence yields h(x)=h(y). Thus h is constant. Levy upward convergence makes h(X_n)=E[1_A|F_n] tend to 1_A because F_∞ is the full path sigma-algebra. Therefore 1_A is a constant indicator and P_π(A)∈{0,1}. AC comes from the Markov conditional laws and conditional-expectation convergence, not from irreducibility itself.
